recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Patient Care makes a new final decision to remodel family history away from the current List plus FamilyMemberHistory pattern.
issue_request: FHIR-8781 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to restore a patient-centric FamilyHistory model, but the accepted resolution kept the List plus FamilyMemberHistory approach and required a note pointing to List.emptyReason for No Known Patient History while referring member-level negation to FHIR-8782.
initial_application: The same historical commit bd3f8a7ba5 explicitly tagged #8781 and #8782 and added FamilyMemberHistory notes for List.emptyReason="notasked" and List.emptyReason="nilknown" whole-list states, plus the complementary condition.code note for individual-family-member absence/negation.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory remains active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-17887 added a concrete member-level negation example, and FHIR-43306 was Resolved - No Change in favor of precoordinated condition.code or text for member-level absence; neither later decision changes the whole-list List.emptyReason guidance requested by FHIR-8781.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source already satisfies FHIR-8781 by preserving the List.emptyReason guidance, so the published artifact is an empty no-change audit commit.
